text: Mumbai, as a financial powerhouse of India, is central to ZX Bank's operations and service delivery. To ensure citywide coverage and facilitate ease of banking, ZX Bank has established a robust presence across all major regions—South, North, East, West, and Central Mumbai. With a network of 34 well-placed branches, customers can access retail, corporate, and digital banking services seamlessly from any part of the metropolis. Each branch is equipped with advanced infrastructure and knowledgeable staff, underlining ZX Bank’s commitment to accessibility, convenience, and quality banking for all Mumbaikars.
